👍 Trial and error

Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF)

In simple words

A way to make a chatbot more helpful: people rate its answers, and those ratings become its reward in reinforcement learning.

A way to make a language model more helpful and polite after its main training. People compare pairs of its answers and pick the better one; a second model learns to predict their choices; then the language model is trained with reinforcement learning to give answers that this judge would score highly.

Example. Imagine a chef who cooks two versions of every dish while tasters say which one they prefer. Soon the chef can guess what the tasters like and keeps improving the recipes to please them.

Related words

  • Reinforcement learningLearning by trial and error: an AI tries actions and gets rewards or penalties for the results.
  • RewardThe score an agent gets after an action, telling it how good the result was.
  • Fine-tuningExtra training that takes a model that has already learned a lot and adjusts it for a particular job.
  • ChatbotA program you can have a conversation with by typing or speaking.
  • AI alignmentMaking sure an AI tries to do what people really intend and value, not just what they literally said.
